name: Curio XR
summary: Curio XR is a groundbreaking, 100% free virtual and augmented reality application that transforms students' educational experiences like never before! Dive into our user-friendly, controller-free navigation and discover a world of interactive learning. Challenge a friend to a game of 3D tic-tac-toe, get instant help from our AI-powered Study Buddy, immerse yourself in captivating 360 videos, and unleash your creativity on the interactive whiteboard. Current content includes anatomy, chemistry, and geometry,
